Tennessee McDonald’s Worker Fired After Going Hands-On In His Pants Mid-Shift And Not Even Trying To Hide It
Audio By Carbonatix
Alright, this might be the single fastest way to lose a job in America.
A McDonald's employee down in Tennessee is officially out of work after a video went viral showing him doing something that should absolutely never happen anywhere near food, let alone behind the counter of a fast food kitchen.
Multiple customers said they saw the guy repeatedly sticking his hand down his pants while working, and not like a quick adjustment either. We’re talking full commitment, going back in multiple times, then just continuing on like everything’s normal.
And yes, according to the video, this was happening while food was actively being prepared.
You can literally see people noticing it, reacting to it, and the guy still doesn’t stop. No panic, no “oh crap I’ve been caught,” just business as usual like this is part of the job description. Unreal confidence, terrible judgment.
At that point it’s not even shocking that someone pulled out their phone and recorded it, because what else are you supposed to do? Politely ignore it and order fries? Absolutely not.
Of course the video explodes online, people start dissecting every frame like it’s the Zapruder film, and within no time the guy is fired. Which… yeah. There’s really no HR meeting needed there. That decision makes itself.
